subject: Island placement + elevation confirmation for SummitTech booth
messages:
From: Erin Shaw <erin@exposales.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Island space availability and elevation request

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the visit last week. Quick update: SummitTech's preferred island (corner near Entrance C) is currently available but there are a couple of elevation constraints from the venue that you'll want to be aware of. Attached is our revised floorplan (island_floorplan_v2.pdf) showing the proposed placement and a low-res site map.

Key notes from venue:
- No rigging above 12 ft in that corridor between Booths C10-C18.
- Backwall max height at this island is 10 ft due to sightline rules.
- Cannot extend into the main traffic aisle — must keep 8 ft clearance.

If you confirm you can live within the 10 ft backwall and provide final graphics specs by Friday, I can lock the space and trigger the exhibitor permit. Also copied venue ops (Frank) on the attachment for direct confirmation.

Attachments: island_floorplan_v2.pdf, venue_elevation_guidelines.pdf

Best,
Erin Shaw
Venue Sales Manager
SummitTech Expo

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Erin Shaw <erin@exposales.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Island space availability and elevation request

Hi Erin — thanks for the notes and the draft plan. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Marissa/Logan/Lauren — looping you in to review sightlines and build feasibility. Quick checklist I want us to confirm before I give Erin the go-ahead: 
1) Can the demo counters and monitor towers fit within the 10 ft backwall constraint?
2) Any objections to the 8 ft aisle clearance (we typically ask for 6 ft, so this is more conservative)?
3) Graphics handoff timeline — Erin needs final specs by Friday (4 days). Can design meet that with production-ready files?

If we can say yes to all three I will confirm with Erin today. If there's anything that requires an exception (e.g., 12 ft backwall), we should surface it now so Erin can petition the venue.

Jordan Blake
Field Marketing Lead
Redwood Inference
(555) 555-0132

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Island space availability and elevation request

On Mon, Jul 16, 2028 at 10:03 AM Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> Marissa/Logan/Lauren — looping you in to review sightlines and build feasibility. Quick checklist I want us to confirm before I give Erin the go-ahead:
> 1) Can the demo counters and monitor towers fit within the 10 ft backwall constraint?
> 2) Any objections to the 8 ft aisle clearance (we typically ask for 6 ft, so this is more conservative)?
> 3) Graphics handoff timeline — Erin needs final specs by Friday (4 days). Can design meet that with production-ready files?

Jordan — short answers below: 
- Demo counters: yes, two 30" counters and one 6ft demo table fit within a 10 ft backwall; we should move the monitor towers forward 18" to prevent sightline blocking for the neighbor booth.
- Aisle clearance: 8 ft is fine; will change our demo flow slightly (two demoers instead of three) during peak periods.
- Graphics: creative can produce print-ready PDFs by Thursday EOD if we lock layout today. We will need the final attendee callout and logo lock from SummitTech by tomorrow noon.

Action items for Jordan: please confirm lock to Erin and request SummitTech logo/booth co-branding files from the organizer. I will prepare the graphics_asset_specs.xlsx and share the Drive link.

Marissa Cole
Senior Events Producer
Redwood Inference

From: Erin Shaw <erin@exposales.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Frank Moss <fmoss@moscone.com>, SummitTech Events <events@summittechexpo.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jul 2028 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Island space availability and elevation request

Thanks Jordan and team — helpful notes. Per venue ops (Frank): the 10 ft backwall is firm for that island because of the emergency egress line. I've attached the official venue elevation guidelines (venue_elevation_guidelines.pdf).

Two quick asks so I can lock the booth:
- Confirm final power schedule (single 20A circuit or do you need 2x20A / 120V split?)
- Confirm demo counter footprint and whether the monitor towers will be freestanding or truss-mounted (truss requires a separate rigging permit).

I can lock the space once you confirm (I have hold until Friday 11:59 PM). If you need an elevation exception, I can file it but it typically takes 72 hours and is not guaranteed.

Attached: venue_elevation_guidelines.pdf

Best,
Erin Shaw
Venue Sales Manager
SummitTech Expo

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Erin Shaw <erin@exposales.com>, Frank Moss <fmoss@moscone.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jul 2028 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Island placement + elevation confirmation for SummitTech booth

Hi Erin / Frank — confirmed, we will proceed under the 10 ft backwall limit.

Answers:
- Power: we need 2x20A circuits (one for demo racks, one for PCs/chargers). Please note we will bring a small UPS for monitors but no additional generators.
- Monitor towers: will be freestanding, moving them forward per Marissa's suggestion. No truss required.

Marissa — please go ahead with graphics and logistics. I uploaded the high-res logo and attendee callout to the Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleFloorplan. Marissa/Logan, copy the graphics_asset_specs.xlsx into that folder and share when ready.

Erin — please lock the island and send the formal exhibitor permit or DocuSign addendum. I'll sign the small location addendum once you send it (link to sign would be ideal).

Thanks everyone — looking forward to a good placement on Entrance C.

Jordan Blake
Field Marketing Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: graphics_asset_specs.xlsx
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/0A1B2C-ExhibitAddendum
